question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: Career is supported by a Sun-Mercury conjunction in the 10th house that links the 4th lord with the 2nd and 5th lord, forming a raja yoga oriented toward authority and reputation [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. The house, lord, karaka, varga and panchanga votes lean in favour of career [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga].

claims.text: The Sun and Mercury conjoined in the 10th house form Budhaditya yoga, emphasising intellect and communication with some support for reputation, slightly reduced by Mercury's avastha [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/18/1].

The Sun and Mercury conjoined in the 10th join the Sun as 4th lord with Mercury as 2nd and 5th lord, forming a kendra-trikona raja yoga that points to authority, reputation and career standing [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12].

Mars in its own sign forms Ruchaka yoga from the lagna, in the 7th, and from the Sun, in the 10th, for courage and leadership, though Saturn's aspect, the Moon's tara and a marana karaka placement weaken it considerably [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/6/1].

The house vote is for career: the 10th from lagna in Aquarius is relatively weak in bhava bala, but the supporting 2nd, 6th and 11th houses are strong, and the 10th from the Moon and the 11th from the Sun hold up well [vote:career.house].

The lord vote is for career: the 10th lord Saturn sits in the lagna in a friendly sign though with modest strength, while Venus as 6th lord is exalted in the 11th and Mars rules several career houses from its own sign in the 7th [vote:career.lord].

The karaka vote is for career: the Sun and Mercury occupy the 10th house with good strength, Venus is exalted in the 11th, and Saturn is in a friendly sign in the lagna but relatively weak [vote:career.karaka].

The varga vote is for career in the D10: Mars is exalted in Capricorn and Saturn is in its own sign there, Venus, the Sun and Jupiter are in friendly signs, and Mercury and the Moon are neutral [vote:career.varga].
The panchanga vote is for career: Mars, lord of the tithi and nakshatra, and the Moon, lord of the weekday, both rule career-related houses and are strong in shadbala [vote:career.panchanga].
